I have launched the empirical search pilot job under Slurm on IBEX (Job ID 53700569) to test the Top-1 subsampling bias directly against an empirical 2,500-genome database slice. I have scheduled a check and will inspect the output upon completion.
I am waiting for the final shapes of the empirical DIAMOND search pilot to complete and the comparison table to be written.
### Hypothesis 3: Soil-Reference Composition After Technical Matching

All work was executed within the assigned local directory [`reproducibility/darkmatter/round6_hypotheses/h3_references/`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/round6_hypotheses/h3_references) and corresponding IBEX directory `/ibex/scratch/projects/c2014/rob/metagenomics/06_darkmatter/p6_hypotheses_clean/h3_references/`.

---

### 1. Verification of Publication Identity and Baseline Recovery

* **SMAG ([Ma et al. 2023, *Nat Commun* 14:7318](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/manuscript/references.bib#L1160-L1169); Zenodo 8223844):** 40,039 global soil MAGs, 129,550,340 proteins (37.86 Gb residues), gene-called via `Pyrodigal v3.7.1 -p meta --no-stop-codon`.
  * **Dark families ($n = 106,042$):** **59.53% hits** ($63,122$); **40.47% absent** (`smag_specificity_summary.tsv`).
  * **Control families ($n = 106,042$):** **98.43% hits** ($104,382$); **1.57% absent**.
* **GEM ([Nayfach et al. 2021, *Nat Biotechnol* 39:499–509](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/manuscript/references.bib#L444-L448)):** 52,515 multi-biome MAGs, 122,978,191 proteins, gene-called via `Prodigal v2.6.3`.
  * **Dark families ($n = 106,042$):** **35.62% hits** ($37,767$); **64.38% absent** (`specificity_summary.tsv`).
  * **Control families ($n = 106,042$):** **97.03% hits** ($102,892$); **2.97% absent**.
* **Prior Error Refuted:** Reviewer Argon previously confused absence with hits, reporting SMAG as having a 40.47% hit rate and GEM as having a 4.93% hit rate, claiming an invented "8.2-fold difference". The true database scale difference is merely $1.053\times$ (129.6M vs 123.0M proteins), yet SMAG recovers **25,355 more dark families** (+23.91 percentage points in hit rate).

---

### 2. Full-Universe Paired Repertoire Decomposition

Evaluated on IBEX across the full $106,042$ universe via [`01_paired_anatomy.py`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/round6_hypotheses/h3_references/scripts/01_paired_anatomy.py) (compact results in [`paired_quadrant_summary.tsv`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/round6_hypotheses/h3_references/results/paired_quadrant_summary.tsv)):

| Cohort | Total Families | Both Hit | SMAG Only | GEM Only | Neither (Double Dark) | McNemar $\chi^2$ ($p$-value) | Discordant Ratio ($\text{OR}$) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Dark** | 106,042 | 35,502 (33.48%) | **27,620 (26.05%)** | **2,265 (2.14%)** | 40,655 (38.34%) | $21,509.97$ ($p < 10^{-300}$) | **12.19×** |
| **Control** | 106,042 | 102,312 (96.48%) | 2,070 (1.95%) | 580 (0.55%) | 1,080 (1.02%) | $836.65$ ($p = 5.81 \times 10^{-184}$) | **3.57×** |

* **Length Stratification ([`length_stratified_quadrants.tsv`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/round6_hypotheses/h3_references/results/length_stratified_quadrants.tsv)):** The SMAG/GEM discordant ratio remains extreme across every length stratum for dark families: **14.16×** for $<100$ aa ($24.6\%$ vs $1.74\%$), **13.42×** for $100–149$ aa, **11.00×** for $150–249$ aa, **8.52×** for $250–399$ aa, and **8.82×** for $\geq 400$ aa ($25.1\%$ vs $2.84\%$).
* **Shared-Hits Identity Shift ([`shared_hits_identity_comparison.tsv`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/round6_hypotheses/h3_references/results/shared_hits_identity_comparison.tsv)):** For the $35,502$ dark families matching both references, SMAG hits are significantly closer than GEM hits: median identity is **61.00%** vs **51.10%** (median $\Delta_{\text{pident}} = +5.20\%$, Wilcoxon signed-rank $p < 10^{-300}$). In **87.99%** of shared cases, SMAG provides a lower $E$-value.

---

### 3. Empirical Pilot: Direct Proof of the Top-1 Subsampling Fallacy

* **Job Execution:** Slurm Job **53700569** ran to completion on node `cn506-11-l` (partition `debug`, 8 CPUs, 32 GB RAM, runtime **145.07 seconds**; logs in [`pilot_53700569.out`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/round6_hypotheses/h3_references/logs/pilot_53700569.out) and [`pilot_53700569.err`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/round6_hypotheses/h3_references/logs/pilot_53700569.err)).
* **Design:** Sampled a deterministic, length-stratified query subset of $2,000$ representatives ($1,000$ dark, $1,000$ control; seed `20261013`). Sampled $2,500$ GEM genomes (~$5\%$ of GEM; $5,815,177$ proteins, $1.835$ Gb residues).
* **Empirical Re-Search vs Post-Hoc Filtering ([`pilot_top1_bias_summary.tsv`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/round6_hypotheses/h3_references/results/pilot_top1_bias_summary.tsv)):**

| Query Cohort | $N$ Queries | Empirical Hits (True Search) | Post-Hoc Hits (Top-1 Filter) | Masked Alternative Hits | **Post-Hoc Undercount Rate** |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Dark** | 1,000 | **126 (12.60%)** | **16 (1.60%)** | **110** | **87.30%** |
| **Control** | 1,000 | **953 (95.30%)** | **58 (5.80%)** | **895** | **93.91%** |
| **Total** | 2,000 | **1,079 (53.95%)** | **74 (3.70%)** | **1,005** | **93.14%** |

* **Methodological Conclusion:** Post-hoc filtering of top-1 (`-k 1`) DIAMOND hit lists severely underestimates hits (by **87.3%** for dark and **93.9%** for control) because dropping a global top-1 hit conceals secondary valid homologs ($E \leq 10^{-3}$) present in the subsample. **True matched subsampling cannot be performed post hoc; physical database re-search is required.**

### 4. Actual Source Availability and Feasibility Audit

* **GEM Sources:** Fully intact and readable on project scratch (`databases/gem/gem_db.dmnd`, `gem_all.faa`, and 52,515 individual `faa/faa/*.faa.gz` files).
* **SMAG Sources (Critical Limitation Disclosed):** `smag_hits.m8`, `smag_hit.ids`, `smag_db_manifest.tsv`, and `smag_supplementary_data_2.xlsx` are preserved and verified in `06_darkmatter/specificity_clean/results/`. However, the built database `/ibex/user/velazqal/eqmags_31/smag/smag_db.dmnd` is mode 700 owned by `velazqal` (inaccessible to `hohndor`), and intermediate fasta chunks were deleted during session `spec_6c` to conserve disk.
* **Full-Test Recipe ([`DOSSIER.md`](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/round6_hypotheses/h3_references/DOSSIER.md)):** Re-extract Zenodo 8223844 into project scratch, construct three 18,000-MAG partitions (SMAG Soil vs GEM Soil vs GEM Multi-Biome), dereplicate each at 95% ANI to standardize species redundancy (~7,500 species each), and run `diamond blastp` across all three arms (~150 CPU-hours total).
